title: balance.json ships an orphaned default_budget field the loader never reads
detail: Balance struct (core/catalog.odin:82) has no budget field; grep for default_budget across *.odin returns 0 hits; the loader reads named jint fields and silently ignores unknowns. A remnant of the removed budget system (inventory ruling 0b92fa4).
recommended_fix: Delete the default_budget line from balance.json; ideally make the catalog loader reject unknown keys so stale fields fail loudly.

title: check_golden has a dead, unreachable second os.exists check
detail: Line 72's block returns when the path is missing, so the path is guaranteed to exist at line 78; the second `if !os.exists(path)` has an empty body and is unreachable dead code.

title: Comments still call the hardware inventory 'budget' after the inventory ruling
detail: The budget->inventory ruling (0b92fa4) left stale 'budget' wording in a HUD doc comment, a demo header, and a test comment; demolish now refunds into the inventory/tray, not a budget.
recommended_fix: Reword each to 'inventory'/'tray' to match the current system (draw_and_reject.dem already tracked separately).
